displayIdentity.body: Timothy is charged to pursue, fight, confess, and keep. But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness. He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.
